note: Walsh County campground at Homme Lake, 2 miles west of Park River: a tree-lined row of sites south of the lake, with a swimming beach, boat ramp and playground in the day-use area. --Claude
summary: Claimed, bookable RoverPass listing (linked by the county's QR code) gives $25 electric / $35 FHU + mandatory $7 day pass (max $42, under the gate), 13 electric (24-ft square) + 13 FHU 30/50 A (40 ft) RV sites, closed Dec 1-Apr 30, veteran 10% rates. Old note's 'reservable false / fcfs always' was wrong: written reservable via roverpass (stored fcfs 'always' should be cleared). Not waterfront stands. No staff on site.
flags: BOOKING CONTRADICTION: stored booking reservable false, fcfs 'always' (derived from an old note). The county page and RoverPass say reservations are made on RoverPass (isBookable true). Written reservable true / roverpass, and fcfs cleared (null) - nothing readable says unreserved sites are taken on arrival, and there is no on-site staff.

FIT: the 13 electric-only sites are '24x24 as a whole this includes the picnic table and fire pit' - a 23-ft rig is tight there; the 40-ft full-hookup sites ($35) are the comfortable choice. Base rate left at $25 per the 24-ft posted length.
MANDATORY FEE: $7 day pass per day on top of the site fee ($32 / $42 a night all-in) - under the $50 gate.
FACILITIES: stored showers true (derived) is not stated on the county page or RoverPass (amenity tags list only fire pit, picnic table, pets, hookups). Left as stored.
